capabilities: Turn website links into preview cards
Open sites in a floating browser window
Fill in missing titles and images in bulk
extras: Floating window and screenshots are desktop only, and cards render in Reading View only. README advises backing up the vault before the bulk 'add missing titles' tool and not syncing the plugin's settings across devices. It contacts the linked sites and the Google favicon service, and caches page data for 14 days.
problem: Plain website links in notes show no preview and open only in an external browser, pulling you out of your notes.
summary: Link preview plugin that turns website links into image cards and opens sites in a floating in-note browser window.
